div.div:
RETRY / FAILURE RULES
Same key + same body returns the recorded result. Same key + changed body returns 409.
Leaving a scene cancels unfinished investigations: release report reservation, keep spent channel cost.
A technical failure uses a compensating ledger entry. A correction never mutates an old report or upload.
